A REQUEST_CHANGES is fixed with NEW commits on the same branch (merge origin/dev first, no amend, no force-push), then the new head goes to the leader for a full round-2 review. Merge with a bare gh pr merge N --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <full headRefOid read from gh pr view in a separate call>, after Check, Docs and Tracker integrity are green on that head; gh deletes the local branch itself. Do NOT put the verdict note on the approved PR's branch (it changes the head): merge the approved head first, then ONE tracker-only PR with the verdict, ACs ticked and the completion; exception: when the code PR's branch already edits the same task JSON, hold the note until after that merge to avoid a conflict. Land the tracker-only PR bare when green; never promote. quest task complete needs the task In Progress first (To Do to Done is illegal). The lore profiles sit at their token budgets: a docs or ADR edit can push implementation or documentation over, and the fix is compacting wording, never max_tokens. A new or reworded user-facing error or hint goes to the leader as an A/B for an opum-doc ruling (DEC-255 (a11) settled the project_not_registered hint, option A). Use biome format --write on your own files. The guard hook refuses a shell variable in a path and composed commands: run gh pr merge and git push bare, each in its own call. Mutate a source file for a control by copying it to a literal scratchpad path first, edit, run the test, then cp it back. The actor is ward-cli-worker, delegated-agent, accountable human jdnewhouse.
